subject: info-dy
title: INFO.DY.------C.CONT.
description: Diagram in AF(D)-9 (Affinity Dynamics, Level One), second of two on book p81, paired with v2-p81-1. Continues the same argument: that affinity-dynamics operates as a structural layer beneath race-thinking, and that information-dynamics must be read multidimensionally. INFO-DY (information dynamics) is crossed with C-CONT (composite continuance): the question is what information-dynamics produces when crossed with composite-continuance — given that 'every projectional thrust of knowledge must take into account its affinity dynamics.' AF-DY (affinity dynamics) branches from the main line and carries three lines: IST-FT (isolated focus); INFO-PROJ (information projection), which carries MT-INFO (multi-information) and, by the chart's only *dashed* line, PROG-EXT-F (progressional extended functionalism); and ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism), which leads to SOC-RT-INT (social reality interpretation). (P)STF (source transfer at its point of idea completion) hangs from the dashed PROG-EXT-F line by a solid line. In Braxton's legend a dotted line amplifies some aspect of the main concept it is connected to.
